last_episode_to_air.name: Would You Like to Select All?
last_episode_to_air.overview: A moment of relief after successfully convincing the chairman cuts short for Mamoru Sasaki, when he ends up becoming the school festival's representative. Just when he falls asleep, more exhausted than ever, Guilty Hole notifies him that he has been selected. In the dream, the school festival was being held, and awaiting Sasaki were Mai Hoshino, Aya Hinata, and Makoto Hojo in maid outfits! As his three students gaze up at him with puppy-dog eyes, willingly serving him as a token of thanks for looking after them, Sasaki was finally able to enjoy his dream...

name: Room of Guilty Pleasure
overview: This overworked and underpaid teacher, Mr. Sasaki, has his whole life turned upside down when he stumbles upon the "Guilty Hole." He thinks it's a dream when he sees the student's shoe lockers have been transformed into selection panels... seeing one that catches his eye, he joking picks her... When she appears in his classroom in the middle of the night, throwing insults at him, but her eyes seem to linger on him, tinged with embarassment. "I'll finish this quickly so... Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to the Guilty Hole, where anything is allowed--
